20261118-chemistry-g09.s.s1.prompt: [M3 Nnyocha Kemistri] Ajụjụ olu gas gbasara Iwu nke mmeghachi omume kemịkal. Na $25^\circ\text{C}$ na $1\text{ atm}$, olu molar nke gas bụ $24.5\text{ L/mol}$. N'otu ọnọdụ ahụ, gịnị bụ olu na $\text{L}$ nke $0.2\text{ mol}$ nke gas a?
20261118-chemistry-g09.s.s1.explain:

Nzọụkwụ 2: $V = 0.2\text{ mol} \times 24.5\text{ L/mol}$.

20261121-chemistry-g10-2.s.s1.prompt: [H1 Nnyocha Kemistri (Dị Elu)] Nsogbu nyocha ọnụọgụ gbasara Njikọ kemịkal na ihe. Ngwọta acid $A$ nwere $[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-3}\text{ M}$ na ngwọta $B$ nwere $[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-5}\text{ M}$. Ugboro ole ka ntinye uche hydrogen ion na $A$ karịrị $B$?
20261121-chemistry-g10-2.s.s1.explain:
Nzọụkwụ 1: $[\text{H}^+]_A = 10^{-3}\text{ M}$, $[\text{H}^+]_B = 10^{-5}\text{ M}$.
Nzọụkwụ 2: Nhata $\frac{1.0 \times 10^{-3}}{1.0 \times 10^{-5}} = 10^2 = 100$.
Nzọụkwụ 3: Ntinye uche $A$ karịrị $B$ okpukpu 100.

20261122-chemistry-g10-1.title: Njikọ kemịkal na ihe

20261122-chemistry-g10-1.material: [H1 Nnyocha Kemistri] Ajụjụ olu gas gbasara Njikọ kemịkal na ihe. Na $25^\circ\text{C}$ na $1\text{ atm}$, olu molar nke gas bụ $24.5\text{ L/mol}$. N'otu ọnọdụ ahụ, gịnị bụ olu na $\text{L}$ nke $0.2\text{ mol}$ nke gas a?
20261122-chemistry-g10-1.s.s1.prompt: [H1 Nnyocha Kemistri] Ajụjụ olu gas gbasara Njikọ kemịkal na ihe. Na $25^\circ\text{C}$ na $1\text{ atm}$, olu molar nke gas bụ $24.5\text{ L/mol}$. N'otu ọnọdụ ahụ, gịnị bụ olu na $\text{L}$ nke $0.2\text{ mol}$ nke gas a?
20261122-chemistry-g10-1.s.s1.explain:
Nzọụkwụ 1: Dị ka iwu Avogadro si dị, olu $V = n \times V_m$.
Nzọụkwụ 2: $V = 0.2\text{ mol} \times 24.5\text{ L/mol}$.
Nzọụkwụ 3: Ngụkọta na-enye $V = 4.90\text{ L}$.
20261122-chemistry-g10-1.s.s1.hint.0: Olu na-adabere kpọmkwem na ọnụọgụ nke moles.
